addr: 211/253, 14th Main Rd, 7th Sector, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102, India

rev.t: It is better than Amruthahalli one. In Amruthahalli there is board customers should buy above 1000 else bag will be charged here no boards like that. And it is cleaner and less crowded. But collection is less.

The kids’ section on the 3rd floor is excellent. The staff are patient, caring, and very supportive, creating a cheerful and comfortable environment for children. They build a great connection with kids and give personal attention. Also, there’s a good collection of comfortable clothes for newborn babies. Highly recommended!
1st floor ladies section-  There are  definitely some gems here- like the super sweet sales lady! Lucky was constantly  hyping me up! really appreciated the enthusiasm!
